name: Kaohsiung
tagline: Harbour art, pagodas and night markets
summary: Kaohsiung is Taiwan's sunny southern port city, with an art-filled harbour, temples on Lotus Pond and great night markets. Explore the Pier-2 Art Center, ride to Cijin Island for seafood, see the Fo Guang Shan Buddha Museum and walk through the Dragon and Tiger Pagodas.
seasonNote: Winter is dry and warm; summer is hot with typhoons.
arrival: Kaohsiung Airport is on the MRT; the high-speed rail reaches Taipei in 90 minutes.
cashTip: Night markets and small shops are cash-only; an EasyCard covers transit and convenience stores.
foodTip: Seafood on Cijin and papaya milk.
buyTip: Pineapple cakes and art prints from Pier-2.
